decisions.recommendation: Export AgentRuntime and createAgentRuntime from @ai-agent-sdk/core, including high-level providers()/modelCatalog() discovery, the preserved merge-extensible typed provider-native tool vocabulary, and exact host-owned run-scoped additionalInstructions: non-whitespace, at most 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, captured before admission, ordered before core mode controls, reused through retry/automatic compaction, usage-accounted, non-persistent and non-authoritative for tools/auth/resources. Freeze RuntimeAgentInvocationOptions.onEvent as sequential bounded run()/generate() progress convenience distinct from durable observability. Freeze eager RuntimeAgentRunHandle with stable runId, single-consumer events, idempotent abort(), success-oriented result and independently awaitable canonical report so Web hosts can observe, control and prove settlement without mutable registry, split histories, or untyped transport configuration. Preserve established AgentDefinition/AgentRunEvent/AgentSession/AgentTeam names as advanced compatibility contracts and use distinct Runtime-prefixed composition protocols.

Allow each runtime agent to select an independent explicit { provider, id } model. Allow agent omission or a route-only target to resolve an explicitly configured provider default. Official factories accept a model-ID string only for a sole claimed route, otherwise a complete target; generic composable providers expose a complete defaultModel target. An omitted agent model selects runtime.defaultProvider when set, otherwise the unique configured default; missing or ambiguous choices fail before dispatch, never use registration/catalog order or a hard-coded model. Capture provider defaults before setup and freeze/expose each resolved agent.model at binding. Invalid explicit targets and failed calls never fall back silently. Preserve reusable defineAgent's object-model versus legacy string/omission discriminant by adding a separate runtime-bound input; legacy advanced compatibility remains unchanged.

Freeze the 18-package/32-specifier Universal/Browser/Node topology, including all established auth, A2A, MCP and observability-node subpaths; map core root to an exact 264-name re-export-only application facade (184 retained current-core names plus 80 reviewed ergonomic additions), keep the canonical owner internal, require package authors to use focused subpaths, enforce exact manifest blueprints for all 18 packages without wildcard or CommonJS exports, render dependency, peer, optional-peer metadata, development-resolution sections, packed files, the retained auth binary, root main/types mirrors, Node-only engines, and non-executable runtime/coreApi/roles metadata from the machine topology, freeze the workspace/external/effective-runtime closure for all 25 target journeys plus core-adjacent probes for every one of the 17 non-core packages, and approve the phase-tracked atomic move of seven base-observability plus 49 agent source files into distinct core internal layers with route-complete compatibility bridges: observability root only, agent root plus ./skill-validation.

Remove @ai-agent-sdk/node and remove the unpublished ai-agent-sdk facade unless the owner names an out-of-repository consumer; add no replacement full facade; approve the three-state documentation cutover that rewrites active guides with target human journeys at I6, then deletes facade-owned READMEs with their packages at I7 while retaining explicitly historical records.

Use independent v1 integer markers for provider, HTTP wire protocol, credential source/store, skill-provider, memory-store, observation-exporter, and tool-source executable families; keep inert values marker-free; require createAgentRuntime providers to expose declarative route claims so every ID/route conflict fails before setup; snapshot executable identity/configuration/method references once at preflight; retain legacy route-in-setup plugins only for the advanced registry; expose route/pluginId/family separately in runtime discovery and freeze official family identity for multiple accounts; require HTTP wire serialization to synchronously return one bounded JSON object that is detached and encoded once per prepared logical call and reused byte-for-byte across retries; require provider-http to validate and linearly bound SSE media type, raw activity, event fan-out and exactly one terminal finish without reconnecting from parser metadata.

Keep tools, toolSources, skills, memory, exporters, and credentials in separate typed slots; compose each live tool source through one synchronous revisioned snapshot per invocation and record only source/revision evidence; make skill providers and memory stores always borrowed in v1, persist only revisioned JSON-safe skill references and require exact provider validation on resume, and use explicit conversation/fixed memory scopes plus snapshot binding IDs to prevent accidental sharing/rebind; keep provider topology immutable after construction; track agent-run, model-catalog, manual-compaction, and team-operation leases so one irreversible shared close task seals late results before provider cleanup, with caller abort accelerating quiescence but never cancelling cleanup.

Make auth-node root env-only, keep /codex explicit, require provider-codex only as an optional peer for that subpath, preserve callable env and Codex read/write APIs as compatibility views, and make new file-backed Codex composition use distinct abortable revisioned credential-source/store contracts.

Every retained package and support layer importing core runtime identity uses a bounded core peer plus exact workspace dev dependency, never a normal core dependency; packed official closures prove one physical core resolution while cross-package protocols avoid nominal instanceof gates.

Provisionally default the metadata diagnostic ring to both 256 events and 1 MiB retained bytes, expose event/byte eviction counters, and re-freeze against the packed migrated core; preserve advanced health while runtime diagnostics and close expose cumulative integration accepted/filtered/dropped/rejected counters, and require expected operation/attempt pairing plus exact event-ID acknowledgments and teardown reports before claiming complete integration traces.

Use side-effect-free named factories that return new frozen wrappers without mutating caller objects in normal documentation; freeze one recommended public entrypoint, typed composition slot, audience, lifecycle ownership rule, direct journey, and compiled wiring proof for every one of the 17 non-core packages; require runtime-bound loggers in provider-setup, credential, tool-source, skill-provider, and memory-store versioned contexts while core independently records lifecycle evidence and exporter plugins receive no recursive logger; require recommended runtime journeys to create runtime before caller-owned MCP/A2A connect or link, pass its bound logger through optional compatibility fields, quiesce runtime before nested integration teardown, install no implicit console sink for standalone use, cover the frozen six-family/27-operation metadata-only evidence matrix through a bounded focused integration-evidence field grammar, use distinct lifecycle versus active tool/team-operation logger channels, and prove post-runtime teardown with independent support-safe reports rather than a closed logger; preserve every provider-specific adapter control through the preferred official plugin factory, infer routes as [id ?? family] when omitted, and keep HTTP/protocol support transitive for normal core-plus-provider consumers; preserve filesystem/exporter operational bounds through their factories, keep MCP asynchronous connect plus caller close explicit, and retain OpenTelemetry as a caller-owned openSpan plus processor bridge rather than misclassifying it as a batch exporter; preserve the existing marker-free caller-owned observability bus and correlated schema-v1 contracts on core/observability, while distinct ObservationExporterPlugin, ObservationDeliveryBatch/Ack, and RuntimeObservationExporterRegistration names own recommended marker/readiness/run-record/ownership semantics; preserve the marker-free candidate/load SkillProvider and use distinct SkillProviderPlugin revision/reference names for runtime composition; keep core leaf tools, approval/user-input brokers, interceptors, hooks, and usage estimators marker-free but capture detached bounded configuration and runtime-used behavior references so post-binding mutation cannot redirect a session while operational state remains live; keep defineAgent/cloneAgent overloads side effect free with an exact model-object versus string/omitted discriminant, while runtime.agent accepts runtime input directly; preserve existing provider/MCP names where suitable, and keep classes/adapters only as advanced exports when they add real value.
Keep exact-wire diagnostics inside observability-node for this migration; any later split requires its own ownership decision.

Freeze the machine-readable Web Platform/Browser/Node 22.12 feature baselines; require separate strict declaration-body checks for mixed Node and Web without Node ambient types; treat the two upstream MCP 2.0.0 Buffer declaration errors as unresolved full-Web portability debt, not a passing gate, and resolve through an upstream correction or reviewed compatible portable type boundary before claiming full support; require packed Workerd, Chromium, and Node checks for Universal packages; retain standards compatibility checks for Deno/Bun, with live provider/network acceptance manual.

Retain A2A as an explicit Node capability, repoint it to core, preserve its root, /client and /server entrypoints by default, add a structural caller-owned transport bridge accepted by both legacy AgentTeam and RuntimeAgentTeam, require RuntimeAgentTeam to supply the active-operation logger, close runtime routing before idempotent reported unlink without assuming ownership of injected transport resources, add reported unlink/dispose paths while retaining existing compatibility methods, and require explicit approval for any further detailed API redesign.

Keep @ai-agent-sdk/mcp and @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-node client-only; place Universal server hosting in @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-server and Node stdio/http hosting in @ai-agent-sdk/mcp-node-server; retain current /client and optional-peer /server compatibility routes; make connected HTTP/stdio factories preserve support-safe primary startup failure plus bounded rollback report through a shared route-reexported McpConnectionError; and explicitly approve every root API move caused by the split.
